name: ZCH_SELECT_CRITERIA_RULES_B
description: This table stores criteria detail rules. Each detail rule contains an attribute, operation, and corresponding attribute value, e.g. a criterion can be that the Registry ID must be less than 1001. Registry ID would be the attribute, less than is the operation, and 1001 is the attribute value. An object record must meet all criteria specified for the batch to be included.

columns.name: DATA_SELECT_CRITERIA_ID
columns.description: Forgien key to Secection Criteria table

columns.name: OBJ_NAME
columns.description: Name of the Object for the criteria set. Example PERSON_PARTY

columns.name: OBJ_DEF
columns.description: The merge object definition, whole package name

columns.name: OPERATION_CODE
columns.description: Operation used to join 2 criteria rules. Values are  = , > , < ,!= and IS NULL

columns.name: RELATION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: The relation between two rules. Values AND or OR

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the attribute in the criteria rule

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
